title: Ramsons RVW 100
subtitle: Vertical Washing Machine (Commercial Laundry range)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Ramsons RVW 100 is a top-loading vertical washing machine used to wash linen and garments with water as the medium. Ramsons sells two distinct '100' vertical washer lines — the plain 'RVW 100' (Commercial Laundry range) and the 'RVW (V) 100' Vertostar (microprocessor/inverter-drive wet-process range). This entry covers the plain RVW 100, confirmed as its own listing on the manufacturer's official site (RVW 20/35/50/75/100/200), separate from the Vertostar RVW (V) series.

overviewDescription: Made by Ramsons Garment Finishing Equipment Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India). The RVW 100 is a 100 kg-capacity vertical washing machine with outer drum and inner basket in AISI 304-grade stainless steel, reduction pulley–belt drive (cast-iron pulleys, imported belts), and basket on self-aligning ball bearings. Used to wet-process linen and garments (washing, and — via chemical dosing box and steam/electric/gas heating — dyeing/stone-washing style treatments).
